datasets.title: Somalia Medium Term Projection FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2020
datasets.description: Somalia Medium Term Projection FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2020. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/somalia_medium_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2020]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Somalia to classify geographic areas by Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) scale. Survey data were spatially aggregated and encoded as GeoJSON/KML features with classification values, collection dates, and scenario projections for 2020 medium-term forecasting.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications reflect acute food insecurity outcomes driven by underlying hazards including drought.
